scope: 36 numbered scalar/combinatorial results in the manuscript snapshot identified by repository.json.
semantic_statement_matching: Manual mathematical comparison, not an automatic proof that PDF prose equals a Lean proposition.

results.title: Treewise conjugacy and Bellman recursion
results.scope_note: Complete scalar/tree conjugacy and attained optima. Smooth-convex GD certificate interfaces from the cited papers are not formalized.

results.title: Kernel properties
results.scope_note: Domain assumptions and both strict ratio inequalities retained. K_gt_sum implies the displayed strict maximum comparison.

results.title: Sharp four-point rearrangement
results.scope_note: Complete statement, or the explicitly documented equivalent formulation, proved over exact real/natural numbers.

results.title: Sign of conjugate polynomial
results.scope_note: The sign identity is encoded equivalently as the negative/zero/positive trichotomy, with z strictly beyond both inner roots.

results.title: Pairing-difference identity
results.scope_note: Complete statement, or the explicitly documented equivalent formulation, proved over exact real/natural numbers.

results.title: Quartic evaluation
results.scope_note: Complete statement, or the explicitly documented equivalent formulation, proved over exact real/natural numbers.

results.title: Abstract balanced-composition principle
results.scope_note: Operation laws are the original abstract hypotheses. silverLaw separately proves that the actual radical kernel satisfies them.

results.title: Balanced optimality and supercomposition
results.scope_note: Complete statement, or the explicitly documented equivalent formulation, proved over exact real/natural numbers.

results.title: All supercomposition equality cases
results.scope_note: Complete statement, or the explicitly documented equivalent formulation, proved over exact real/natural numbers.

results.title: Complete maximizing root-split set
results.scope_note: Equivalent unified formula using 2^l*((nu±1)/2), avoiding natural subtraction in l-1. No extra optimizer is admitted.

results.title: Resolution of Zhang-Jiang conjecture
results.scope_note: ConPP sums are represented by Tree.primitiveSum. Step indexing is n=N-1; the even tie theorem writes the positive valuation as l+1.

results.title: All optimal composition trees
results.scope_note: Complete statement, or the explicitly documented equivalent formulation, proved over exact real/natural numbers.

results.title: Silver power inequality
results.scope_note: Full nonnegative real inequality and all equality cases, via a compact-interval calculus proof equivalent to the hyperbolic argument.

results.title: Sharp power envelope; dyadic equality
results.scope_note: Full sharp power envelope and equality iff N is a power of two, for the actual recursive U.

results.title: Adjacent-ratio contraction
results.scope_note: All recurrence and contraction bounds proved; uses an algebraic mean bound instead of the paper derivative argument.

results.title: Canonical bi-Lipschitz interpolation
results.scope_note: The actual supremum-defined F is proved to interpolate the grid, be bi-Lipschitz with the exact constants, have the stated range and midpoint rule, and be unique.

results.title: Exact symmetric phase and uniqueness
results.scope_note: Full positive periodic Lipschitz profile, exact identity, uniqueness, strict minimum bounds and maximum; includes the stated numerical expression for the Lipschitz constant.

results.title: Symmetric scalar and rate cluster intervals
results.scope_note: Both complete cluster intervals and nonconvergence, with actual strictly increasing integer subsequences.

results.title: Tight objective-gap phase
results.scope_note: Full scalar phase identity, uniform explicit remainder and cluster interval. Smooth-convex GD worst-case tightness is still an external certificate input.

results.title: Reciprocal sandwich
results.scope_note: Finite-N sandwich, actual Bellman doubling, dyadic-ray convergence and exact phase bounds proved. No imported asymptotic axiom.

results.title: Uniform OBS-F phase and cluster interval
results.scope_note: Actual piecewise affine logarithmic interpolants, uniform phase limit, exact Lipschitz constant, uniqueness, rays and full cluster interval.

results.title: Sharp support inequality; equality ratio
results.scope_note: Actual infimum-defined interior root, uniqueness, sharp support bound and all positive and boundary equality cases proved.

results.title: Nonconstant phase; strict support separation
results.scope_note: Strict minimum/support separation, nonconstancy, distinct minimum and maximum and the upper support enclosure.

results.title: Number of optimal plane trees
results.scope_note: Actual finite enumeration of all optimal plane trees, root-class disjointness, cardinal recurrence, dyadic, odd and even-odd-part formulas proved.

results.title: Derivative products and one-sided derivatives
results.scope_note: Integral representation, uniform slope and binary-product limits, actual infinite products, uniform absolute log tail, nondyadic differentiability/continuity and both dyadic expansions.

results.title: Strict corner at 3/2
results.scope_note: Exact generated rational intervals for the radical recurrence; all square inequalities checked by the kernel. Strict left/right derivative separation and nondifferentiability proved.

results.title: Nested finite phase-minimum certificates
results.scope_note: Nested finite-grid certificates, all gap bounds and convergence; explicit cached array algorithm and at most 30*2^k scalar operations in the documented real-RAM model. The optional level-17 printed decimals are not a Lean interval certificate.

results.title: Local A-versus-K inequalities
results.scope_note: Complete statement, or the explicitly documented equivalent formulation, proved over exact real/natural numbers.

results.title: Discrete modulus for U, W, C
results.scope_note: All three discrete increment/modulus bounds, retaining the stated constants and quantification over every admissible LF.

results.title: Support barrier and exact deficit identity
results.scope_note: Support barrier and C lower bound for actual W, exact deficit identity, and nonnegativity of every summand proved.

results.title: Strict interior power envelope
results.scope_note: Full strict interior envelope. A stronger explicit tent-deficit estimate is proved and passed to the continuous limit.

results.title: Contact fraction and dyadic exclusion
results.scope_note: Both contact identities and all strict rational bounds proved using exact arithmetic, real powers and logarithms.

results.title: Strict dyadic-ray separation
results.scope_note: Strict separation of the dyadic-ray limit from the support constant.

results.title: Constant-phase rigidity
results.scope_note: Constant-profile Bellman limit for arbitrary positive split ratio and sharp-support rigidity, with no asymptotic hypotheses imported.

results.title: Strict separation at every phase
results.scope_note: Pointwise strict separation of the phase profile from the support constant, and strict separation of its minimum over one period.

results.title: Upper phase enclosure
results.scope_note: Global maximum-phase Bellman test at arbitrary split ratios and resulting support upper barrier.
